module_summary: Source side of a clearable gray-code CDC FIFO: a FIFO source half stores words and exports gray write pointer, while a reset-controller half sequences isolate/clear phases, gating valid/ready.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source-domain data written into the CDC FIFO storage.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source write valid, gated by isolate request.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: FIFO not-full ready, masked during isolation.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: FIFO data array exported to destination domain.

anchors.name: async_wptr_o
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer sent to destination.

anchors.name: async_rptr_i
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer from destination for full detection.

anchors.name: src_clear_i
anchors.why: Requests a synchronized clear sequence of the FIFO.

anchors.name: src_isolate_req
anchors.why: Isolation request gating valid and ready during clear sequence.

anchors.name: src_clear_req
anchors.why: Clear request from reset controller clearing FIFO source.

anchors.name: src_clear_pending_o
anchors.why: Indicates clear sequence in progress (isolate asserted).

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_o
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase sent to destination reset controller.

anchors.name: async_reset_req_o
anchors.why: Request for clear-phase transfer to destination.

anchors.name: async_reset_next_phase_i
anchors.why: Clear-sequence phase received from destination controller.

groups.name: fifo_src
groups.description: Gray-code CDC FIFO source: storage and write pointer logic.

groups.name: clear_controller
groups.description: Reset-controller half sequencing isolate and clear phases across domains.
